generation.explanation: Both big squares have side a+b, so they have equal area. On the left, four right triangles surround a tilted square of side c. Slide the same four triangles into the right square, and the leftover space becomes an a×a square and a b×b square. Removing the same four triangles from each side leaves c² = a² + b². Click the triangles to recolor them.
